_comment: Persistent state for the cleanup-loop. The orchestrator reads this at the start of every iteration and writes it at the end, so the loop survives context compaction and session restarts. Populated by the initial scan (11 parallel scanners, 2026-06-15). pending[] is ordered by priority: score desc, then deletable LOC desc, with lower-risk server modules (have a vitest net) ahead of client modules (build-gate only).
guidingPrinciple: The best code is the one that was never written. Prefer DELETE > SIMPLIFY > REWRITE.

baseline.note: verify-gate.sh enforces: no NEW tsc errors (ceiling ratchets down; 24->23 after populateRepository dedup), all server tests pass, client vite build succeeds.

smells: backupDatabase/restoreDatabase/getConnectionString each repeat the tenant-scoped project lookup inline instead of using resolveProjectOr403
pending.notes: SIMPLIFY: route the 3 inline tenant lookups through the existing resolveProjectOr403 helper (already used elsewhere). Behavior-preserving.
pending.risk: low — reuses an existing, tested helper

smells: provisionCodespace is a ~120-line god function (8 sequential steps)
pending.notes: REWRITE: extract _ensureImage/_setupNetwork/_attachEdgeNetwork helpers to shrink the god function. No dedicated test — lean on build+tsc gate, guardian should add a thin one if feasible.
pending.risk: medium — no direct test; behavior-preserving extraction only

smells: trivial pass-through re-export wrapped in a 13-line copyright header (peer index.js files are 1-2 LOC)
pending.notes: SIMPLIFY: trim the boilerplate header to match sibling index.js files. Pure formatting — client build gate suffices.
pending.risk: low — client, build-gate only, no behavior change

smells: 4 near-identical hooks (useUserDockerContainers/Images/Networks/PortBinding) repeat the same fetch-on-page-change + cleanup-on-unmount boilerplate
pending.notes: SIMPLIFY: extract a useUserResource(slice, operation, opts) factory; re-export the 4 named hooks so callers are unaffected. NO client unit tests — verify via build + manual import-shape check.
pending.risk: medium — no FE tests; keep public hook names identical

smells: back-compat aliases StatusChip/StatTile/IconButton exported but never imported anywhere
DataTable has speculative optional params (getRowKey/render/actions) unused by call sites
pending.notes: DELETE: remove the 3 unused aliases (grep-confirm zero imports first). DataTable signature trim is a separate step.
pending.risk: low-medium — client; confirm zero imports before deleting

smells: errText helper redefined locally in 4 pages instead of a shared utility
pending.notes: SIMPLIFY: extract errText to client/src/utilities and import in the 4 pages. Behavior-preserving, low blast radius. No FE tests — build gate only.
REWRITE: extract EnvironmentsModal to its own file, consolidate modal state. HIGH RISK — no FE tests; do strictly behavior-preserving extractions, one at a time, build-gate each.
pending.risk: high — largest client god component, no test net

pending.notes: REWRITE: extract ChannelModal + RuleModal. HIGH RISK — no FE tests. Pair with the errText extraction step.
REWRITE: extract CreateDatabaseModal + BackupModal. HIGH RISK — no FE tests.
REWRITE: extract AddDomainModal, unify loading state. HIGH RISK — no FE tests.

smells: god component 429 LOC with 2 inline modal components (DeployModal ~110, CatalogBrowser ~100)
pending.notes: REWRITE: extract DeployModal + CatalogBrowser to files. HIGH RISK — no FE tests.

smells: humanFileSize and formatBytes are two near-identical byte formatters; humanFileSize has worse precision and one caller
pending.notes: SIMPLIFY: migrate the single humanFileSize caller (CreateDockerContainer) to formatBytes, delete humanFileSize. Confirm the caller first.
pending.risk: low-medium — client; one caller to migrate

knownBugs_notForSimplifier._comment: Behavior-CHANGING fixes surfaced by the scan. The Simplifier's contract is behavior-PRESERVING, so it must NOT silently 'clean' these. Parked here so they aren't lost; fix them deliberately (with a test) outside the cleanup loop, or move into manual_review.
